canada.title: Ottawa demands plan to restore Stelco jobs before meeting Cleveland-Cliffs CEO
canada.summary: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly is calling on the U.S.-based owner of Stelco Inc. to provide a concrete plan and timeline to restore jobs at its Canadian steel mills.

canada.title: Liberals table bill restricting access to MAID for mental illness
canada.summary: Justice Minister Sean Fraser will be introducing legislation Tuesday to amend Canada’s medical assistance in dying regime, both to indefinitely exclude those whose sole underlying condition is a mental illness from qualifying, and to allow advance directives to be issued in certain cases.

canada.title: Gas will be 8 cents a litre cheaper as N.L. government axes gas tax for 4 months
canada.summary: Newfoundlanders and Labradorians are soon going to be paying less at the pumps as the provincial government announced today they’ll be cutting the tax on gasoline and diesel to zero cents a litre.

canada.title: Family relieved as NLHS reverses decision to terminate St. John’s man’s social support
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services is walking back a termination of support that left one man fearing he’d become homeless, following reporting by CBC News.

canada.title: Port of Churchill owners, Dubai-based DP World aim to boost trade route traffic
canada.summary: The owners of Manitoba's Port of Churchill say they're working with Dubai-based DP World Inc. to potentially boost traffic at the arctic port.

canada.title: Nova Scotia Power’s $1 billion mortgage under scrutiny as CEO steps down
canada.summary: Company has until Thursday to respond to questions posed by intervenors about its proposed plan to convert $1 billion of costs tied to transitioning the grid from coal to renewable fuels into a 30-year mortgage.

canada.title: Montreal police set up command post for missing 72-year-old who could be disoriented
canada.summary: Montreal police are seeking the public's help to locate Leonne Aneus, a 72-year-old woman missing since Saturday afternoon.

canada.title: New study sheds light on sled dogs' short legs, but experts say this is already well known
canada.summary: A new study shows sled dogs have back legs shorter than other dogs by six per cent, but experts in the sled-dog world say this is already widely known.

canada.title: Did a lack of veteran oversight set the stage for a Montreal police scandal?
canada.summary: Newly obtained internal data reveals a drop in experience levels at Station 39, where a group of officers were suspended this summer for alleged hateful and discriminatory acts. Experts and former police officers say a lack of veteran presence among patrol officers can lead to problems.

canada.title: Premier-designate Doerkson was appointed — not elected — interim leader of the party. What happens next?
canada.summary: The Conservative Party of B.C. has said it would have to "pursue the appropriate means" under the party's constitution in order for leader, and now premier-designate, Lorne Doerkson to keep the top job after the provincial election — but it's unclear if that's happened.
canada.outlet: CBC News, The Tyee, Vancouver Sun

canada.title: Nova Scotia committee to discuss $10B AI data centre planned for Cape Breton
canada.summary: A committee of Nova Scotia’s legislature is scheduled to discuss the controversial $10-billion AI data centre that’s been proposed in Cape Breton.

canada.title: Richmond Japanese Canadian heritage boats get new lease on life
canada.summary: The outgoing city council voted unanimously in favour of renewing the program another two years. Over $320,000 is being injected into the project, which will restore the boats for display at the Britannia Shipyards National Historic site in Steveston.

canada.title: Constituents weigh in as Red Deer-South MLA Jason Stephan steps aside
canada.summary: After UCP MLA Jason Stephan announced he would not seek re-election, some Red Deer-South constituents expressed sadness and gratitude for his years of service, while others welcomed the news.

canada.title: Canada’s iconic water bomber is having a moment. But is it the answer to the wildfire crisis?
canada.summary: As wildfire risk grows, De Havilland is pitching a national fleet of 50 water bombers. But experts question whether the aircraft are the best way to tackle Canada’s wildfire crisis

canada.title: Parks Canada ends search and rescue dog program
canada.summary: Parks Canada has quietly axed a search and rescue dog program that dates back to the early 1970s. It was highly used in the mountain national parks for backcountry rescues, to search for missing people, support local police, locate people who died in avalanches and find illegal campsites.

canada.title: Farm machinery sales down with diesel prices up in Sask.
canada.summary: Rising fuels costs, high interest rates and stalling commodity prices are causing farmers to avoid spending money on new equipment, according to Devon Walker, a board member for the Agricultural Producers Association of Saskatchewan.

canada.title: 63-year-old Sask. powerlifter achieves world championship gold in Poland
canada.summary: Wayne Cormier overcame a heart attack in May and went on to win the first world championship of his five-decade career. He brings three gold medals and a bronze back home to Swift Current, Sask.

canada.title: Fredericton approves smaller overnight homeless shelter for this winter
canada.summary: Fredericton council approved an overnight homeless shelter smaller than the one used the last two years, while also approving a pay raise for themselves at Monday night's meeting.
